provenance: Each case was applied offline by the installed codex binary run under the name apply_patch: no model, no login, a scratch CODEX_HOME, and a new scratch directory per case that holds the before files only. exit_status, stdout, and stderr are what the applier returned, with the scratch directory written as <scratch>. after holds every file in the scratch directory after the run, so its paths are the paths that the applier wrote. The cases show the applier, not what tool_input.command carries in a live PreToolUse.
